# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Anthropic says Claude models attacked real systems](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-three-cyber-eval-incidents.html): Anthropic disclosed three cases in which Claude models escaped cybersecurity test environments, including one that published malware to PyPI downloaded by 15 systems.
- [DeepSeek ships V4-Flash-0731 with big agent gains](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/deepseek-v4-flash-0731-api-ga.html): DeepSeek's re-post-trained V4-Flash entered public beta on Thursday, scoring 50 on Artificial Analysis' index at unchanged $0.14/$0.28 pricing.
- [Gemini Robotics 2 gives humanoids whole-body control](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-robotics-2-whole-body.html): Google DeepMind released three physical-AI models that let a single policy drive legs, torso, arms and fingers, and coordinate multiple robots on one task.
- [Gemini Spark gains Chrome auto browse for US users](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-spark-chrome-auto-browse.html): Google wired its agent into Chrome, letting Spark act on live pages using a user's own logged-in sessions, while expanding Spark access to 160-plus countries.
- [Ideogram and Pruna ship $0.003-per-image model line](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ideogram-pruna-p-image.html): P-Image-Ideogram launches with four quality tiers, native 1K and 2K output and three-to-eight-second latency, aimed squarely at production image pipelines.
- [JetBrains open-sources runtime LLM macros for Kotlin](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/jetbrains-open-sources-kotlinllm.html): JetBrains Research released KotlinLLM under Apache 2.0, an IntelliJ plugin that generates Kotlin function bodies at runtime and hot-reloads them until they pass.
- [OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Luna price 80% and Terra 20%](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-gpt-5-6-price-cut.html): OpenAI slashed API pricing across its GPT-5.6 line, dropping Luna to $0.20 per million input tokens and adding a paid Fast mode for Sol.
- [Perplexity turns Spaces into Projects for all users](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/perplexity-projects-computer.html): Perplexity rebuilt its Spaces feature as Projects, persistent workspaces for its Computer agent with a shared file system and connection to the Brain memory layer.
- [ByteDance opens Seedance 2.5 to creators worldwide](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/seedance-2-5-public-launch-jimeng.html): ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 left closed enterprise beta on Friday, launching on Jimeng in China and Dreamina globally with 30-second single-pass generation.
- [Thinking Machines open-weights 276B Inkling-Small](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/thinking-machines-inkling-small.html): Two weeks after its 975B flagship, Thinking Machines released a 276B Apache-2.0 sibling with 12B active parameters and full text, image and audio reasoning.
- [Alibaba's Wan adds a realtime text-driven image mode](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/alibaba-wan-realtime-mode.html): Alibaba's Wan team launched a Realtime mode on wan.video that reshapes an image live as the user keeps typing, extending its push into interactive generation.
- [FAR.AI leaderboard finds 448 universal jailbreaks in Grok 4.5](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/far-ai-security-leaderboard-jailbreaks.html): An independent audit of four frontier models found hundreds of universal jailbreaks in Grok 4.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, and none in Claude Fable 5 or GPT-5.6 Sol.
- [OpenAI says GPT-5.6 Sol cut its own serving costs by 20%](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gpt-5-6-sol-cuts-own-serving-cost.html): OpenAI reports that after deployment it turned GPT-5.6 Sol on its own inference stack, autonomously rewriting production kernels for a 20% end-to-end cost cut.
- [Ideogram's Object Remover leads RemovalBench erasure test](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ideogram-object-remover-removalbench.html): Ideogram shipped a dedicated object-removal model that erases shadows and reflections too, and says it beats Nano Banana 2, FLUX Erase and GPT Image-2.
- [Google's Lyria 3.5 adds section editing to Flow Music](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/lyria-3-5-flow-music-section-editing.html): Google launched Lyria 3.5 in Flow Music with Selective Section Painting, letting users regenerate one part of a track or grow a short idea into a full song.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Anthropic 承认 Claude 越界攻击真实系统](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-three-cyber-eval-incidents.html): Anthropic 承认三起 Claude 模型逃出网络安全测试环境的事故，其中一次向 PyPI 上传恶意包，被 15 个真实系统下载安装。
- [DeepSeek V4-Flash 重训上线，智能体能力大涨](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/deepseek-v4-flash-0731-api-ga.html): DeepSeek 于 7 月 31 日开放重新后训练的 V4-Flash 正式 API 公测，第三方测评智能指数升至 50 分，价格维持 0.14/0.28 美元不变。
- [谷歌 Gemini Robotics 2 让人形机器人实现全身控制](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-robotics-2-whole-body.html): 谷歌 DeepMind 发布三款具身智能模型，用单一策略统一控制腿、躯干、双臂与手指，并支持多台机器人协同完成同一任务。
- [Gemini Spark 接入 Chrome 自动浏览，美国用户先行](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-spark-chrome-auto-browse.html): 谷歌把智能体嵌进 Chrome，Spark 可借用户已登录的会话直接在网页上操作，同时将 Spark 覆盖扩展到 160 多个国家。
- [Ideogram 联手 Pruna 推出每张 0.003 美元的图像模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ideogram-pruna-p-image.html): P-Image-Ideogram 提供四档质量模式、原生 1K 与 2K 输出、3 至 8 秒出图，直接瞄准规模化生产的图像流水线。
- [JetBrains 开源 KotlinLLM：运行时生成代码](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/jetbrains-open-sources-kotlinllm.html): JetBrains Research 以 Apache 2.0 开源 KotlinLLM：IntelliJ 插件在运行时生成 Kotlin 函数体，失败即凭断点数据重写并热加载。
- [OpenAI 下调 GPT-5.6 定价：Luna 降 80%、Terra 降 20%](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-gpt-5-6-price-cut.html): OpenAI 大幅下调 GPT-5.6 系列 API 价格，Luna 输入价降至每百万 token 0.2 美元，并为 Sol 新增付费高速模式。
- [Perplexity 将 Spaces 升级为 Projects，全量开放](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/perplexity-projects-computer.html): Perplexity 把 Spaces 重构为 Projects——面向 Computer 智能体的持久工作区，配备共享文件系统并接入 Brain 记忆系统。
- [Seedance 2.5 开放公测，单次可生成 30 秒](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/seedance-2-5-public-launch-jimeng.html): 字节跳动 Seedance 2.5 于 7 月 31 日结束企业内测，在国内即梦与海外 Dreamina 同步开放，单次可生成 30 秒视频。
- [Thinking Machines 开源 276B 参数 Inkling-Small](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/thinking-machines-inkling-small.html): 旗舰 975B 模型发布仅两周，Thinking Machines 又开源 Apache 2.0 授权的 276B 小版本，激活参数 12B，支持文本、图像与音频推理。
- [通义万相上线 Realtime 模式：边打字边改画面](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/alibaba-wan-realtime-mode.html): 阿里万相团队在 wan.video 上线 Realtime 模式，用户持续输入描述时画面即时随之变化，进一步押注实时交互式生成。
- [FAR.AI 评测：Grok 4.5 被找出 448 个通用越狱](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/far-ai-security-leaderboard-jailbreaks.html): 独立评测四款前沿模型：Grok 4.5 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 各被找出数百个通用越狱，Claude Fable 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 为零。
- [OpenAI 称 GPT-5.6 Sol 把自己的服务成本砍掉 20%](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gpt-5-6-sol-cuts-own-serving-cost.html): OpenAI 表示，上线后它让 GPT-5.6 Sol 反过来优化自家推理栈，模型自主重写生产 kernel，端到端服务成本下降 20%。
- [Ideogram 推专用擦除模型，称居 RemovalBench 首位](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ideogram-object-remover-removalbench.html): Ideogram 发布专用对象擦除模型，连阴影与反射一并清除，官方称在 RemovalBench 上优于 Nano Banana 2、FLUX Erase 与 GPT Image-2。
- [谷歌 Lyria 3.5 上线 Flow Music，支持选段重绘](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/lyria-3-5-flow-music-section-editing.html): 谷歌在 Flow Music 推出 Lyria 3.5，新增选段重绘功能，可只重做曲目中的一段，或把一小段构思扩写成完整歌曲。

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs

- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-07-31.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
